column1: TABLE 2. Data From the Five Subdivisions of the Five Hippocampi Showing Individual Values and the Means, Standard Deviations, and Coefficients of Variation for the Group¹

¹ SD = standard deviations; CV = coefficients of variation SD/mean. These observed quantities are noted OSD and OCV in text dealing with distribution of variances. ΣP = total points counted over sectional profiles of neuron-containing layer(s), multiplied by a constant to obtain V; CE(ΣP) = observed variance of estimate ΣP, also variance of estimate V. ΣQ⁻ = total neuronal nuclei counted on all sections with optical disectors. Q̅⁻ = mean neuronal nuclei per frame (disector sample). CE(Q̅⁻) = variance of Q̅⁻. V = volume of layer of subdivision in which Nv was estimated. N = number of neuronal nuclei per mm³; Nv = total number of neurons (N = V × Nv); CE(N) = computable variation of stereological estimate of N; Biol = estimate of true biological variance of N. [N/Nv labels in this footnote retained as printed.]
² Number of sections separated by 3 mm used to estimate both Nv and V.
³ Number of disector samples on all sections; noninteger values reflect frames not entirely within delineated region.
